ui.legend: Topo quality is measured from important basic information (for example images). Extra information that is not always available adds bonus points (for example setter dates and videos).
ui.scoreHint:
The percent is the required points of this spot and everything inside it, divided by the maximum.

A drawn line is 2 points. A line style is 5. A portrait image is 10. A description on a crag, sector or area is 5.

A video is 3 bonus points. A routesetter with a set date is 3 bonus points. Bonus points sit beside the bar and do not change the percent. Projects do not need a line style to reach 100% topo quality. Videos and setter dates on projects award no points.

A spot with nothing to score is Platin.
ui.checkHint.lineFa: 3 bonus points for every published line with a routesetter and a set date. This is not required to reach 100% topo quality. Projects do not award these points.
